title: Men's Beard Color Natural Black B101

details.dangerWarnings: Cautions: Avoid contact with eyes. Can cause an allergic reaction. Keep away from children. Do not dye your eyelashes. Take care not to let the colour enter the mouth or nose when colouring the moustache. Always do a patch test on a small area of skin before use, as hair dye can cause allergic reactions.
details.description: Bigen Men's Beard Color covers grey in the beard, moustache and sideburns without staining the skin. Non-drip cream with olive oil and taurine, applied with the fast-touch comb. No ammonia. Shade: Natural Black B101.
details.usageInstructions: Squeeze out equal amounts of cream from both tubes into the mixing tray and mix well. Apply with the flat part of the applicator comb to the sideburns and colour the moustache with the front part, taking care it does not enter the mouth or nose. When the desired colour is obtained, wet the coloured part with water, rinse with lukewarm water and shampoo well.
